fit: source initial5 four tasks, all method gradients frozen before evaluation
heldout: same four source tasks, independent initial6, same three starts and two step sizes

optimization_geometry.raw: production J=10 native_FD - 0.1 amplitude_MSE - 0.1 texture_TV; compare raw mean-sign, PCGrad-sign, PCGrad-vector and max-min
optimization_geometry.normalized: divide heldout native J gains by the corresponding FIT task gradient L1 norms; compare all normalized counterparts
optimization_geometry.screen: in >=4/6 start-step settings, max-min must improve worst-task gain over ALL three relevant baselines and have nonnegative worst-task gain; mean gain must retain at least 90% of the strongest mean baseline in those settings
optimization_geometry.numerical_tolerance: 1e-8 on normalized comparison scales; zero-margin LP abstains
optimization_geometry.no_claim: first-order LP optimality alone is not native-rendering or closed-loop success

fusion.fidelity: aggregate interaction error/truth energy ratio at least 25% smaller than AA displacement counterpart and improved on at least3/4 tasks, excluding no cases silently; report near-zero denominators
fusion.native_step: exploratory diagnostic even if fidelity fails; no full training allowed without successful native gate
fusion.screen: joint effect increases >10% while both solo effects do not increase beyond tolerance on >=3/4 states in >=4/6 start-step settings
fusion.protection_scope: only local action-output protection; not closed-loop task competence

ellipsoid.zero_score_interpretation: a score identically zero cannot be accepted based on arbitrary argmax selection
ellipsoid.action_metric: production affine-unscaled first-five translation control coordinates
ellipsoid.gate: offline ranking is auxiliary; a candidate must provide nonzero useful gradients before native update testing

reporting: all starts and steps; both raw and normalized tail/mean; no target-model query or test-driven texture selection
